summary: The platform schedule contains at most ten calls, too few for honest runtime scaling, while the accepted closure performs fixed work per invocation and timer release.

replacement_checks.evidence: Each invocation either executes once and registers one timer or replaces one pending tuple; each timer release reads at most that tuple and registers at most one successor.
Cases cover one and ten calls, zero and maximum delay, same-time ordering, exact-boundary calls, empty arguments, overwriting, chained windows, and idle-separated bursts.
